newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end lower on interest payment.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end lower on interest payment.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates closed lower on Wednesday after the state treasury paid T$24.5 billion in bond interest to fuel the banking system, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate ended at 5.000 percent against Tuesday's 5.075 close, with 30-day commercial paper at 5.00 against 5.00-5.05. Dealers expected liquidity to remain loose as routine payments continue to return to the banking system.

The bond market saw no transaction in the afternoon, with investors concerned that a booming stock market may siphon money from the bond market. The 10-year 84/1 bond yield was at 5.75 against 5.735-740 after morning trade. --Julie Hu (5080815)
